(Explanation #1): === Addressing The Debunks === Addressing The "Mistranslation" Debunk: Okay, so the idea for the mistranslation debunk is that the kanji for the original Japanese scan states something different from the actual translation, mainly around this specific character being this "間" which has multiple meanings in the Japanese language but most commonly means either space or time, however when paired with "空" which more commonly means an empty space we can come to the conclusion that in this context the kanji of "空間" is meant to represent spacetime or a time-space. which is not only consistent with the statements of the series but is consistent with the idea that the Ōtsutsuki clan are all capable of creating dimensions of their own. ==Gallery== Put other pictures of the character here. ==Others== Put some minor information about the character here.
